stages.title: Implemented slices
stages.summary: Working in the study or in Hazel-backed Furl. A checkmark covers the stated slice; tool boundaries and semantic policies remain provisional.

stages.title: Next · Offside recovery and palettes
stages.summary: Move/Copy and whole-term targeting are in Hazel now. Compare offside containers and reusable term palettes in the new study, then choose a small retained-piece contract to port.

stages.title: Then · scopes and source transformations
stages.summary: Turn selected before/after proposals into actual gestures, one operation at a time. Integrate and validate Hazel transformations as each one needs them.

stages.title: Later · broader recovery and inspection
stages.summary: Keep these visible without making them prerequisites for a meaningful editor. Move an item up when it becomes the next useful experiment.

actions.mouse: Move or Copy, or held Option/Alt: pause briefly at a boundary and click its faint line.
actions.keyboard: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter below; add Shift for above. Enter keeps its native cell meaning.
actions.rule: Retain the originating pattern/expression column. Give a new draft a fresh generated word name; avoid existing definitions and free names.
actions.study_detail: Gap click and ⌘/Ctrl+Enter insert a two-hole draft and focus its expression.
actions.hazel_detail: Native named drafts in let scopes, function bodies and match arms. Same-column focus and one Undo. Backspace removes an empty definition whose name is unused.
actions.next: Extend boundary targeting as scope/grouping gestures are designed; preserve single-transaction insertion.

actions.mouse: Move: drag row whitespace at least one character away from syntax. Operators and names take precedence. Double-click cells to edit.
actions.keyboard: Focus the row; Space picks up, ↑/↓ chooses a destination, Enter drops, Escape cancels.
actions.rule: Refactor offers conservatively checked destinations. Free edit permits dependency breaks within the owning let scope. A definition subtree moves without its continuation; the derived result is not an ordinary movable let.
actions.study_detail: Whole-row pickup, Slot/Float previews, keyboard movement, dependency refusal and cancellation.
actions.hazel_detail: Whole binding subtrees move within their owning let scope. Slot/Float previews, bounded resistance at refused destinations, semantic checks, values retained, and keyboard parity.
actions.next: Cross-scope movement and dependency carry remain separate work; broaden certified moves per operation.

actions.mouse: Rows: drop outside the code rectangle to delete. Returning inside resumes the move.
actions.keyboard: Backspace in either cell when both cells are empty; ⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Backspace requests populated-row deletion. ⌘/Ctrl+Z restores.
actions.rule: Backspace on an empty unused definition cleans it up. Populated removal requires Free. Restore the previous row in the originating column, or a surviving adjacent cell.
actions.study_detail: Off-canvas drop, Backspace on a two-hole row, and explicit row-delete chord; result stays.
actions.hazel_detail: Empty unused drafts can be removed with Backspace; Command/Ctrl+Shift+Backspace and off-canvas row drag remove populated rows in Free. One Undo restores the original identities.
actions.next: Explore unused-name cleanup separately; general term deletion is C5 and persistent recovery is H2.

actions.action: Create a reference from a binding
actions.mouse: Connect or held Option/Alt: pull a wire from a binder to a hole/use target. Click-to-pick/place also works.
actions.keyboard: Focus binder, Enter/Space, Tab to a hole/use target, Enter. A general in-scope-name chooser remains to do.
actions.rule: Resolve by binder identity and lexical context, not matching spelling. Never silently capture a different same-named binding.
actions.study_detail: Pull or click-pick a centered wire, then connect to either factor; the original binder stays.
actions.hazel_detail: Centered wires create real Hazel variable occurrences in expression holes; Refine checks expected type and actual lexical binder identity.
actions.next: Add a general in-scope chooser and other syntax targets; currently a visible binding anchors the cable.

actions.action: Move or unplug a variable use
actions.mouse: Drag an existing use. Free edit permits moving to a hole/use target or releasing elsewhere to leave a hole.
actions.keyboard: Space on a use, Tab/Enter to move; Backspace/Delete removes it. Undo restores its binder ID.
actions.rule: Source remains intact until commit. Escape, blur and pointer cancellation restore it. Releasing away from targets deletes only in Free edit.
actions.study_detail: The word and wire move together. Another factor moves the use; any non-target release unplugs it.
actions.hazel_detail: Free edit moves a variable occurrence to a hole/use or unplugs on a non-target drag release. Source IDs survive movement and Undo. Removal closes the source slot; moves animate both ends, with native text, SVGs and hit regions moving together.
actions.next: Generalize from variable uses to tokens/forms in C4/C5; do not assume every form has a wire.

actions.action: Cancel a connection / trace its binding
actions.mouse: After click-pick, a non-target click cancels and is consumed. A missed binder drag retracts without editing. Hover a use to trace it.
actions.keyboard: Escape cancels even after focus leaves the lab; focused uses can show the same optional link.
actions.rule: Click-away cancellation and drag-away deletion are different gesture paths. Only the latter can remove an existing use.
actions.study_detail: Click-away retracts a picked cable in every policy. Escape cancels. Optional hover links show binding identity.
actions.hazel_detail: Click-away / Escape retract a picked wire. Hover/focus traces are confined to Move and Copy; native binding IDs determine the endpoint.
actions.next: Compare combined targeting in I3; retain the click-cancel versus drag-unplug distinction.

actions.mouse: Undo restores the prior row order, contents or reference slots, including during cable retraction.
actions.keyboard: ⌘/Ctrl+Z in either lab. Hazel-backed Furl also already offers Redo.
actions.rule: One committed gesture, one history entry; previews and cancellation add none. Persistent stash recovery is H2 below.
actions.study_detail: Both labs undo row/use deletion, movement and insertion. Recovery is already present; there is no stash.
actions.hazel_detail: All ported structural commits use native whole-program Undo/Redo. Previews/cancellation add no history; source occurrence IDs are restored.
actions.next: Persistent stash recovery is H2; keep one transaction per future gesture.

actions.action: Shared pickup and temporary cell editing
actions.mouse: Move/Copy: syntax handles pick terms; whitespace with a one-character buffer picks rows. Double-click activates native cell editing or values.
actions.keyboard: Tab activates a cell; Enter/F2 edits a focused row. Escape returns to row focus.
actions.rule: The current palette solves hit-target competition. Its mode boundaries are an experiment, not semantic categories.
actions.study_detail: Rows grabs any column; double-click activates a cell. Tab/Enter/F2 provide keyboard access.
actions.hazel_detail: Edit / Move / Copy replace the separate Rows / Connect tools. Both structural tools retain double-click editing and Escape to leave it.
actions.next: Compare mixed row/token targeting in I3; the current mode split is replaceable.

actions.mouse: Live: click a native cell. The study also explores double-click cell entry under row primacy.
actions.keyboard: Live: arrows cross cells at boundaries and retain the desired column, including short lines.
actions.rule: Values and derived result labels are not editable cells. Inspection and syntax focus stay distinct.
actions.study_detail: Row focus and Tab work here; native cross-cell caret geometry is exercised in the live editor.
actions.hazel_detail: Up/down retain horizontal targets; left/right cross editable cell boundaries.
actions.next: Retain native navigation when adding row and term gestures; keep Shift-selection in active text.

actions.mouse: Existing comb clicks, all/one branch choice, and selected-value arrows.
actions.keyboard: Existing cross-cell arrows and Ctrl+Alt+←/→ for branch inspection.
actions.rule: Furling changes projection. Explode/implode rewrites source and is listed separately as E5. Neither should be silently substituted for the other.
actions.study_detail: Not implemented in the two gesture labs; available in the live editor and the separate reference.
actions.hazel_detail: Lets/functions/matches, all-or-one branches, stem cycling and selected-value call arrows.
actions.next: Keep this baseline; compare animated and alternative furling affordances in V3.

actions.action: Show binding, expression and value columns
actions.mouse: Use the live toolbar visibility toggles.
actions.keyboard: Focus a visibility control and press Space.
actions.rule: Hiding an attribute does not alter syntax or runtime state. Recover a hidden caret column when entering it.
actions.study_detail: The two gesture labs keep their columns fixed.
actions.hazel_detail: Binding/expression/value visibility, comb visibility and pattern indentation toggles exist.
actions.next: Preserve the shared grid; extra semantic and trace columns are V4 below.

actions.mouse: Preview a candidate while dragging; settle identified rows on release.
actions.keyboard: Keyboard moves get the same preview and settled state; reduced-motion gets immediate transitions.
actions.rule: Old editor used UID-based 150ms position transitions. Do not animate syntax by interpolating token text or save intermediate states.
actions.study_detail: Continuous insertion/reordering, slot reversals, word opening, wire momentum/retraction and reduced motion.
actions.hazel_detail: Native rows use 180ms reflow and Slot/Float motion. Reference creation, replacement, removal and movement animate slot changes; cables share the study renderer. See the separate motion audit for row exits, Undo/Redo and projection gaps.
actions.next: Animated furling and arbitrary-form movement remain V3/C4; compare new projection cases as they are introduced.

actions.source: Current interaction study / proposed next step
actions.mouse: Buttons latch a pointer tool. Held Option/Alt selects the lab’s tool in the study; in live Furl it gives names Connect and other row space Rows.
actions.keyboard: Focusable toolbar buttons/selects; no global text-modifier chords are stolen.
actions.rule: Policy covers structural gestures; ordinary typing remains unrestricted on both platforms. Tool targeting and semantic permission are independent provisional choices.
actions.action: Tool buttons and structural policy gates
actions.study_detail: Edit/Rows/Connect, contextual Option/Alt, and Refactor/Refine/Free edit work for the bounded labs.
actions.hazel_detail: Icon-only Edit / Move / Copy tools, independent Refactor / Refine / Free policies, plus held Option/Alt for temporary Move. Tool separation remains provisional.
actions.next: Keep tools independent of semantic policy; refine targeting and certified operations separately.

actions.action: Copy a row — shared Copy variant
actions.mouse: Copy: pick row whitespace and choose a slot in the same let scope.
actions.keyboard: Copy tool; focus a row, Space, arrows, Enter; Escape cancels.
actions.rule: Sample Copy at pickup; button and modifier choose the same action. Fresh syntax IDs/binder identity, collision-free name, correctly mapped internal uses. Start in Free edit; no general refactor claim.
actions.target: Whole row; later any selected form
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Fresh native IDs, collision-free copied pattern names and renamed recursive self references. Refactor/Refine require a total definition and preserved bindings. One Undo.
actions.next: Decide whether Copy also needs a momentary modifier; later permit cross-scope copies with explicit binding rules.

actions.action: Move or copy a whole expression term
actions.mouse: Move/Copy: grab an operator, delimiter or atomic term. Drop on a hole, or replace a complete destination term in Free. No whitespace insertion.
actions.keyboard: Focus the handle, Space, Tab to destination, Enter; Escape cancels.
actions.rule: Refine copies into compatible holes without changing reference bindings. Moving a populated source leaves a hole and requires Free. Self/ancestor moves are rejected; grouping is preserved.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Uses Hazel TermData source ranges and measured delimiter shards. Source and destination previews highlight complete terms. Existing binding wires are the atomic-variable instance.
actions.next: Broaden source motion beyond the current carried preview; embedded projector copies remain explicitly unsupported.

actions.source: Current interaction study / proposed next step
actions.mouse: Free: move a term off the program; references keep their existing unplug-on-miss gesture.
actions.keyboard: Focus an expression handle and press Delete/Backspace in Free.
actions.rule: A deletion leaves a native hole and one Undo entry. Generic inside-canvas misses cancel; reference misses retract their cable and unplug. The offside study may replace this distinction.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Native whole-term removal, including delimited expressions. Patterns/types are not part of this expression-term gesture.
actions.next: Use the offside study to replace destructive disposal with retained cards where appropriate.

actions.source: Current interaction study / proposed next step
actions.mouse: Try overlapping affordances with explicit hit priority. Buttons can latch the same state as held modifiers; a Copy option need not be another tool.
actions.keyboard: Preserve native editing chords; expose the same target/action choices by focus and command.
actions.rule: Edit/Rows/Connect and Shape/Inspect are hypotheses, not an approved semantic taxonomy. Semantic operation, source granularity, pointer affordance and permission remain independent axes.
actions.action: Compare combined targeting and modifier buttons
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Move/Copy use shared targeting with syntax priority and a neutral one-character buffer before row pickup. Insertion hints start at the pattern column and wait 160ms before fading in.
actions.next: Evaluate whether the neutral buffer and delayed hints are enough; keep the mode boundary provisional.

actions.mouse: Current baseline: comb toggles the view. Proposal: compare selecting the form then expanding, with no additional code row.
actions.keyboard: Focusable view action with the same transition; preserve source selection and caret through expansion.
actions.rule: Match columns/single-branch motion is live, including cancellation and reduced motion. Source/projection furling animation remains incomplete. Explode/implode is E5.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Match column layout has a live icon and a horizontal comb drag: pull a secondary stem inward or the single fork outward. Native branches gather/spread continuously; Escape restores the view. Source/history stay unchanged. Let/function furling motion remains open.
actions.next: Evaluate the match layout gesture; then explore continuous source-to-projection furling for lets, functions and matches.

actions.action: Extract an expression term into a binding
actions.mouse: Move: drop the term on the boundary immediately above its own row.
actions.keyboard: Focus the term handle; Command/Ctrl+Shift+Enter extracts above it.
actions.rule: Preserve source identities and replace the original term with a fresh reference. Refactor/Refine accept only the conservative total fragment with preserved bindings.
actions.study_detail: Preset before/after arithmetic extraction only; the drag and general transformation are not implemented.
actions.hazel_detail: Native term extraction for literals and compound expressions; extracting an already-bound name is refused because it only creates an alias. Unresolved-name definition remains available. Scoped source splice; no full refactorings-branch merge.
actions.next: Broaden placement and totality reasoning; source transformation is distinct from furling existing code.

actions.mouse: Move: drop the unresolved use on the boundary above its row.
actions.keyboard: Focus the unresolved use; Command/Ctrl+Shift+Enter.
actions.rule: Keep the occurrence; create a binder of that name with a hole. Check for collisions.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Creates a same-named definition with a hole and focuses its pattern. Refine/Free only; checked mode rejects capture of an existing bound reference.
actions.next: Consider choosing a wider enclosing scope without accidental capture.

actions.mouse: Old editor: click between words or drag from its word palette. Proposed: native Hazel completion or a compact structure menu.
actions.keyboard: Use Hazel typing and completion; Tab moves through new holes.
actions.rule: Do not reimplement a second token editor. Old Space made a new word; that mapping should not replace Hazel’s input model.
actions.study_detail: Reusable term-template copy-out works in the separate Offside study, including forms with holes; not a Hazel palette yet.
actions.hazel_detail: Native Hazel text editing and completion are embedded; a Furl mouse template palette is not.
actions.next: Choose a small template set and integrate native completion/form constructors; add search when the collection grows.

actions.mouse: Select a contiguous row range, then Group; compare Alt-drag / left-then-up as an expert gesture.
actions.keyboard: Row selection + “Group into block”; name the resulting binding.
actions.rule: A nested let changes scope. Reject or explicitly export bindings still used outside the chosen block.
actions.study_detail: Preset grouping states; no row-range selection or grouping gesture.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Make range selection explicit and show any escaping uses before a real grouping operation.

actions.mouse: Structure: drag the top or bottom comb endpoint across row boundaries.
actions.keyboard: Focus an endpoint; arrows preview moving it one boundary, Enter commits.
actions.rule: The endpoints change lexical extent, not CSS height. Show escaping uses and keep required exports.
actions.study_detail: Preset escaping-use example; endpoints cannot yet be dragged.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Test endpoint hit priority and refusal feedback; reproject actual candidate source.

actions.mouse: Pull the top comb boundary downward; crossed definitions become parameter candidates.
actions.keyboard: “Abstract leading rows”; choose a range, preview parameters and call, then commit.
actions.rule: Create a function plus a call supplying old definitions. Preserve evaluation order; update all affected uses. Start with one tuple parameter.
actions.study_detail: Preset function-and-call rewrite; no source-editing gesture.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Start with a tuple parameter and one call, then validate evaluation-order and escaping-use cases.

actions.mouse: Structure: drag parameter slots or use an endpoint command.
actions.keyboard: Commands plus directional parameter navigation; reuse the same transform planner.
actions.rule: Hazel patches known calls and rejects bare escaping uses in relevant transforms. Adding argument holes is an edit; reordering needs evaluation-order checks.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Adapt and test Hazel’s transform; the inspected refactor branch is not imported or exposed in Furl.

actions.action: Turn a binding into a match
actions.mouse: After a refutable pattern is complete, show a fork preview; accept on the comb.
actions.keyboard: Commit pattern, then command “Branch on this pattern”.
actions.rule: Deck proposes automatic creation. Start with an explicit acceptance so intermediate typing does not rearrange the editor; add a fallback hole without claiming semantic equivalence.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Prototype explicit acceptance of the fork; do not count the add-branch storyboard as this interaction.

actions.mouse: Structure: click or pull the match fork right. In normal mode it keeps its current view action.
actions.keyboard: At the branch handle, command “Add branch”; Tab enters its pattern/body.
actions.rule: A branch is a pattern plus a body, not a let row. Place a new branch before a catch-all or use a coverage witness.
actions.study_detail: Before/after empty-list arm only; no working fork gesture.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Implement typed pattern/body insertion and coverage-aware placement.

actions.mouse: Drag a whole branch column by its comb handle in Structure mode.
actions.keyboard: Pick up a branch handle; ←/→ previews, Enter commits.
actions.rule: Case order is semantic. Refactor requires disjointness or a stronger proof; the branch currently uses a conservative disjoint-pattern test.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Reuse candidate picking; require disjointness or stronger reasoning for Refactor.

actions.action: Inline a binding or one use
actions.mouse: Pull a definition toward an occurrence; preview whether it is copied or consumed.
actions.keyboard: Commands “Inline binding” / “Inline this use”; use Hazel FeedLet and InlineLet.
actions.rule: Distinguish one use from all uses. Preserve precedence, capture avoidance, evaluation behavior, and comments.
actions.study_detail: The un-abstract storyboard covers one fixed single-use function, not generic inlining.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Separate one-use/all-use commands and validate capture, evaluation behavior and comments.

actions.mouse: Refactor drag pauses at a dependency; offer a preview carrying the necessary rows.
actions.keyboard: At a blocked move, choose “Move with dependencies”.
actions.rule: Make the larger operation explicit. Do not silently turn a small reorder into a helper extraction.
actions.study_detail: Preset move-with-dependency states; no dependency-carry drag.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Offer an explicit enlarged candidate at a blocked move; never silently change the operation.

actions.action: Extract a helper at a scope boundary
actions.mouse: Pull a dependency group beyond a function ceiling, then accept a helper preview.
actions.keyboard: “Extract helper”; review free variables as parameters and rewritten uses.
actions.rule: Hazel LiftFunction handles a specific contiguous dependency run and enclosure shapes, not every arbitrary selected Furl region.
actions.study_detail: Preset helper extraction with a free variable; no general gesture.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Validate the supported enclosure shapes in Hazel before broadening the gesture.

actions.mouse: Select an expression, choose “Expose intermediates” / “Inline intermediates”.
actions.keyboard: Use Hazel Explode / Implode commands; bind an optional chord after testing conflicts.
actions.rule: Introducing let-bound intermediates is a source refactor. Merely furling existing syntax is a view change; keep the two actions distinct.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Exercise actual source transformations, with identity tracking; do not equate this with V1/V3 view changes.

actions.action: Recover from a persistent stash / trash
actions.mouse: Proposal: choose a retained item and drag it to a valid typed destination.
actions.keyboard: A recovery chooser with preview and Enter to restore; Escape cancels.
actions.rule: Undo already works (H1). A persistent trash/stash does not. Keep the item until successful reinsertion; preserve or deliberately remap binding identity.
actions.study_detail: The revised Offside rail parks/restores rows and whole terms, fills nested holes, replaces subterms, reorders cards, scrolls and collapses. Move/Copy share the same starter and parked cards; interiors are inert syntax.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Integrate syntax-only cards with native source transactions and destination policy checks; decide persistence. Lexical binding metadata is deferred.

actions.action: Add types, environments and trace columns
actions.mouse: Proposal: attribute chooser and trace pinning alongside existing visibility toggles.
actions.keyboard: Focusable attribute controls and commands that preserve the active source target.
actions.rule: Existing binding/expression/value visibility is complete. Additional types, environments, assertions and pinned invocation columns are not.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Extend the existing visibility baseline (V2) only after deciding which new attribute helps a real task.

actions.action: Specialize or step from an inspected sample
actions.mouse: Select a live call, then inspect a substituted view. A separate command applies a source rewrite.
actions.keyboard: Value arrows navigate; explicit “Step here” / “Bind argument” are source commands.
actions.rule: Current call/branch browsing exists. Applying a rewrite from one sample is not implemented here and does not prove equivalence for every input.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Keep live call browsing (V1) separate from an explicit source-changing specialization.

actions.mouse: Click a microphone at the focused cell, dictate, correct a small transcript, then insert.
actions.keyboard: Focusable record/stop and accept/cancel controls; ordinary typing remains available.
actions.rule: One insertion transaction at a retained source target. A late transcript cannot land in a different cell. Service choice remains open.
actions.study_detail: No interaction implemented in this document.
actions.hazel_detail: Not wired into Hazel-backed Furl.
actions.next: Choose a provider and measure correction effort on names before adding a recording surface.
